data.body: b69c held-out validation cycle 1: restored 4 hidden files; 33/53 cases green initially. Corrected oracle-only assumptions under revert-first reasoning: the ticket never fixed the option spelling, so tests now use implemented --target; status exposes both nested and flat lock facts, so canary fixtures now mirror the real flat fields; the canary must pass max-age to enforce its configured window; advancing message is asserted semantically rather than requiring the word RUNNING; legacy GitHub heartbeat tests explicitly select the one-release rollback. These corrected cases were RED on the original absent-status/canary baseline already captured. Re-run yielded 44 green / 9 red, plus a new RED writer-local-identity case. Genuine gaps re-dispatched without test disclosure: detail_status, local writer identity, exact rollback env key, semantic failure_kind, and runtime-observable 100/200 ms CAS backoff. Attempt cycle 2 started.
